limitations: Exploratory tuning on reused validation set; only3independent confirmationseeds; not globaloptimum.
Test split previously examined in prior study; no new untouched holdout; exploratory replication, not fresh confirmation.
COCO training-image exposure in initial pretraining and near-frame/person correlations mayinflateperformance.
Advanced candidate bundles loss, augmentation andsampling changes; no isolated attribution toindividualcomponents.
Native pretrained diagnostic retains80classhead andfilters person; untuned training resets oneclass classifier and mismatched HyperACE tensors; not anidentical initializationcontrol.
Same6epochs but differing schedulerhorizons, architecture reconstruction/initialization interventions and actualwalltimes; combined engineering-recipe evidence, not a newarchitectural invention.

One tiny-LR screening attempt was interrupted after two complete epochs and part of epoch3, then rerun from initial weights with the identical frozen six-epoch recipe. Partial evidence is preserved and excluded from selection; extra compute is disclosed, not counted as another hyperparameter candidate.

Two-stage checkpoint selection ranks only native-FP16-best checkpoints using FP32 validation; maymiss FP32best among other epochs. Adaptive6th recipe and zero deployment option are validation-informed; neither proves globaloptimality nor isolates components.

Archived historical latency/FPS came from a Python-list loader that processed532images in one batch despite batch1 requested; those timings are invalid for batch1 and excluded. Corrected timings use verified fileloader batch1 with forward-hook proof,32warmup and500 measured frames. Accuracy protocol and locked checkpoints are unchanged.

latency_protocol_correction.correction: Source is project-local txt list. on_predict_start verifies LoadImagesAndVideos.bs1 and restores frozen sample order. on_predict_batch_start verifies one source image. Network forward prehook asserts tensor batch dimension1 for every call.

interruption_recovery.method: Preserve all original files; fresh rerun same frozen six-epoch recipe from original pretrained weights, identical seed, no tuning based on partial metrics. Native checkpoints do not guarantee exact augmentation/RNG continuation.

interruption_replay_audit.compared_fields: All CSV fields except elapsed time
interruption_replay_audit.interpretation: Identical non-time metrics and losses support deterministic fresh replay of the interrupted prefix. Selection remains restricted to the eventual complete replacement six-epoch run.

cpu_drift.ratio_denominator_policy: Per-tensor ratio omitted when initial L2 <=1e-12; pooled ratio is L2delta/L2initial, unlike per-element relative drift. BN and parameter ratios describe different tensor groups and are not equivalent causal effect sizes.
cpu_drift.interpretation: Tensor drift is descriptive; does not demonstrate BN-buffer causality without matched protocol evaluation.

bn_controlled_diagnostic.interpretation: Controlled selected-checkpoint evaluation: trained parameters identical, only BN runningmean/var/counters changed; evidence specific to this checkpoint/protocol, not complete causaltrainingablation.

execution_cost.clock_scope: CSVelapsed includes per-epoch training andvalidation; excludes pretraineddiagnostics, finaltest/latency, setup andoverall orchestration idle; historicalprefix durations are NOT newconsumption; actual_total_new_training_seconds sums COMPLETE fresh records only. Extra interrupted attempt consumed at least interrupted_completed_epoch_seconds plus unknown partial epoch3; total_new_training_seconds_lower_bound includes that known overhead.

historical_control_reuse_audit.interpretation: Same seeds, initialization, architecture, source, datasetmanifest, all functional arguments and exactly matching savedEMA tensors through6epochs support reusing prefix checkpoints forcontrols. Historicalwalltimes and dates differ; test andlatency must be freshly reevaluated after winnerlock.
historical_control_reuse_audit.limitation: Manifesthash verifies splitidentity, not independently all historical image/label bytes; seed42 exact tensors/metrics provide strong end-to-end consistency evidence.
